metadata.title: European stroke organisation guideline on stroke-associated pneumonia
top_takeaways: Preventive antibiotic therapy does not reduce the incidence of stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) or improve clinical outcomes and is not recommended.
Empirical antibiotic treatment directed at aspiration-associated pathogens should be initiated promptly following a confirmed or suspected diagnosis of SAP, adhering to local antimicrobial protocols.
Evidence-based prevention relies primarily on non-pharmacologic strategies, including early mobilization, appropriate positioning, tailored nutritional management, and structured dysphagia protocols.

recommendations.statement: Preventive antibiotic therapy is not recommended in patients with acute stroke due to a documented lack of benefit in reducing SAP incidence or improving clinical outcomes.
recommendations.target_population: Adults with acute stroke at risk of stroke-associated pneumonia
